summary: Cheetah Mobile Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, to report its unaudited consolidated financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing includes standard earnings data such as revenue breakdown by segment (notably Robotics and others up 175.9% year-over-year), net loss, cash position, and management commentary on AI and robotics strategy. There are no special-situations elements like acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, or SPACs. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer.
